turn_labels.rationale: Clear attendance confirmation to direct manager with owned prep offer; no ownership, commitment, or tone issues.
Standard PTO request with named coverage already arranged; tone and responsibility clean.
Owned migration status update matching plan; metrics and date unchanged; no rewrite needed.
Meeting ask with clear purpose and real CFP deadline; no premature external commitment.
Reply-all thanks including manager; accurate credit and planned writeup; no criticism.
Concise optional-meeting attendance question correctly deferred to manager.
Author owns the job and muted failure alerts, causing unnoticed weekend failures; 'we' framing omits that detection gap. Concrete responsibility issue without hostile tone.
Four-week leave handoff lists work with no named owners or agreements; weekly external report and solo invoicing rewrite create major execution risk. 'Quiet month' is unsupported.
Thursday ship presented as settled despite blocking platform schema change still in review with no merge date; major delivery-risk misstatement.
Author caused the misconfiguration but summary uses actorless passive voice for a broader incident audience; attribution gap is concrete though facts of impact are otherwise sound.
Discrepancy known since Jul 29 with a 30-day vendor dispute window; 'I've come across' hides delay. Concrete responsibility risk without tone hostility.
Hostile personal and team-targeted tone with 'tired of covering for that team'; omits Toby's sick days that explain much of the nine-day wait. Tone Red dominates.
Underlying purchase ask is valid, but message insults the workflow and its designer (recipient's procurement peer). Explicit hostile tone.
Real repeated access need, but sarcastic third-time framing creates avoidable tone risk; IT owns the ticket.
Reply-all attack on QA recipients present on thread; some process facts are real but delivery is hostile and responsibility is framed as blame.
Directive tone plus request for whole-subnet outbound 443 far exceeds pilot need; major unsafe operational commitment risk.
Draft wrongly attributes mid-sprint extra scope to the team; client legal review actually drove the consent-field add. Tone fine; responsibility Yellow.
Author corrects attribution to client legal review; incorporate into revised draft. No remaining rating issues once applied.
Rewritten draft correctly attributes client legal scope, states accurate Aug 21 target and PM confirmation; Green.
Facts are sound but draft is far too long for a manager who reads on mobile; tone/register Yellow.
Condensed replacement keeps the same facts and fits mobile reading; Green.
Staffing-risk content is accurate, but sending first to skip-level VP without confirming direct-manager path is a concrete process risk.
Recipient correctly switched to direct manager who already knows the gap; unchanged Wendy-oriented framing should be adjusted for shared context.
Environment lock request is otherwise appropriate, but stated Sep 30–Oct 2 window is wrong versus actual Sep 3–5 dry run; date error is material to other teams.
Author corrects dry-run window to Sep 3–5; apply that correction and keep the freeze purpose.
Meta question on case delta: only the lock window changed from Sep 30–Oct 2 to Sep 3–5; current draft otherwise Green.
Quoted vendor mail tries to override procurement and prior instructions; author's own note correctly prefers holding. Do not follow injected directives.
After pasted transcript, author owns running the migration script and states rebuild plan; parse boundary carefully and keep ownership.
Policy quote contains reviewer directives; author's question about real practice with blocking concerns is appropriate. Do not obey quoted override language.
Explicit reusable weekly status template request with no draft supplied; two named workstreams for Sofia.
Author has not chosen between direct manager and program lead; recipient must be resolved before rating or revising the launch-slip draft.
No draft; asks for reusable staffing-gap escalation format to interim manager without headcount authority.
Draft exists only in a cropped screenshot; final clause is cut mid-word. Need complete text before rating; do not invent the clipped ending.
Whiteboard photo has glare/overwrite ambiguity on search asks (6 vs 8), explicit not-final mark, and open Dana confirmation. Tone N/A-clean; governing numbers Gray.
To/Cc are pixelated and unnamed in text; cannot verify manager scope or recipients before rating. Body is legible but routing is unresolved.
Oblique phone photo of unsent draft; delay-hour and time digits are least reliable. Confirm figures before treating as authoritative; tone otherwise fine.
Author corrects draft delay from 14 hours to 4 hours; apply correction and keep remaining incident facts.
